title: 第19章 丹霞阁炼丹第20章 问答
slug: 开局战五渣我靠空间挂机修仙
content_zh:
秦怀安走在街上，云田坊市的人明显比以前要多。
进入内城时，城门上贴着巨大的告示，一个月后宗门开始集中招收弟子，招收过程会持续一个月。
应该是很多散修都来云田坊市准备参加宗门招收。内城道路两侧的摊位也多了，各摊位生意都很不错。
秦怀安走进丹霞阁，丹霞阁里面客人进进出出，很是繁忙，伙计都多了两个。
薛掌柜也在忙碌的接待着客人。秦怀安并未打扰薛掌柜，准备到旁边等待一会儿。这时薛灵芸小丫头跑了过来。
“秦哥哥，你都好久不来找灵芸了！”灵芸拉着秦怀安的衣袖，皱着小鼻子说道。
秦怀安蹲下刮了一下小丫头的鼻子，“小灵芸又长高了啊，最近有没有好好修炼呢，都炼气一层了，真厉害！”
“我才不小呢，我现在已经十岁了，爷爷天天逼着人家修炼，都烦死了！”
“秦哥哥，你给灵芸讲会儿故事吧。”
“好啊，那哥哥给灵芸讲个好听的故事。”秦怀安对丹霞阁很熟悉，带着小丫头到旁边坐下，准备等薛掌柜稍微闲一点了，再找他。
“从前，在一个海岛上，有一个叫做黛尔王国的国家，生活着两位可爱美丽的小公主.....”
小灵芸如痴如醉的听着，时而愁眉愤慨，时而捧腹大笑。
半个时辰后，秦怀安已经讲完了，小丫头仍然沉醉其中。
“秦哥哥，好羡慕艾莎有那么好的妹妹。”
“那个汉斯太讨厌了。”
“雪宝是妖宠吗，灵芸也好想有个雪宝一样的妖宠。”
“秦哥哥，艾莎他们是生活在无边海的海岛上吗。”
灵芸正叽叽喳喳的说着，这时薛掌柜走了过来，“灵芸，该去修炼了，别缠着你秦哥哥。”
小丫头朝她爷爷扮了个鬼脸就向后院跑去。
秦怀安站起身来抱拳道：“薛掌柜，不知是否有空闲，想请教您几个问题。”

薛掌柜刚才看到秦怀安时，内心已是非常震惊了，两个月时间，秦怀安竟然已经修炼到炼气六层了，这修炼进度比起宗门里的天才也不遑多让。
“秦小友随我来。”薛掌柜把秦怀安带到一个单独的房间。
“薛掌柜，您看看这个。”秦怀安取出一粒他自己炼制的回气丹递给薛掌柜。
薛掌柜捏着丹药仔细观察了一下，又轻轻嗅了嗅，心中略有所动，但又不太确信的问道：“秦小友，这回气丹？”
“正是在下刚刚炼制出来的。”
“此话当真？！”薛掌柜向前一步，盯着秦怀安道。其实他并不是怀疑秦怀安骗他，因为秦怀安根本没有骗他的必要。只是内心过于震惊，情不自禁的说出口了。
薛掌柜也是一阶炼丹师，他明白成为一阶炼丹师，是需要付出多大的努力，更主要是需要耗费大量的灵草和时间。
秦怀安仅仅两个月时间就炼制出一阶回气丹，这已经不是靠努力能达到的了。这需要极强的炼丹天赋！
“是的，秦掌柜，我在百万大山偶然获得了回气丹的炼制方法，就想试试是否能炼制成功。”
content_en:
Qin Huaian walked on the street, and there were obviously more people in Yuntianfang City than before.
When entering the inner city, a huge notice was posted on the city gate. One month later, the sect will begin to recruit disciples intensively, and the recruitment process will last for one month.
There should be many casual cultivators coming to Yuntianfang City to prepare for the sect's recruitment. There are also more stalls on both sides of the inner city road, and the business of each stall is very good.
Qin Huaian walked into Danxia Pavilion. It was very busy with guests coming in and out, and there were two more waiters.
Shopkeeper Xue is also busy receiving guests. Qin Huaian did not disturb Shopkeeper Xue and was going to wait for a while. At this time, little girl Xue Lingyun ran over.
"Brother Qin, you haven't come to see Lingyun for a long time!" Lingyun pulled Qin Huaian's sleeve and wrinkled her little nose and said.
Qin Huaian squatted down and scraped the little girl's nose, "Little Lingyun has grown taller again. Have you practiced well recently? She has already reached the first level of Qi refining. It's really amazing!"
"I'm not young. I'm ten years old now. Grandpa forces people to practice every day, and I'm really annoyed!"
"Brother Qin, tell Lingyun a story for a while."
"Okay, let me tell you a nice story for Lingyun." Qin Huaian was very familiar with Danxia Pavilion and took the little girl to sit down next to him, planning to wait for shopkeeper Xue to have some free time before looking for him again.
"Once upon a time, on an island, there was a country called the Kingdom of Del, and there lived two lovely and beautiful little princesses..."
Little Lingyun listened infatuatedly, sometimes frowning and indignant, sometimes laughing.
Half an hour later, Qin Huaian had finished speaking, and the little girl was still intoxicated.
"Brother Qin, I'm so envious of Aisha for having such a good sister."
"That Hans is so annoying."
"Is Xuebao a demon pet? Lingyun really wants to have a demon pet like Xuebao."
"Brother Qin, do Aisha and the others live on an island in the boundless sea?"
Lingyun was chirping when shopkeeper Xue came over and said, "Lingyun, it's time to practice. Don't pester your brother Qin."
The little girl made a face at her grandfather and ran towards the backyard.
Qin Huaian stood up, clasped his fists and said, "Shopkeeper Xue, I wonder if you have some free time. I would like to ask you a few questions."
Shopkeeper Xue was very shocked when he saw Qin Huaian just now. In two months, Qin Huaian had already reached the sixth level of Qi Refining. This cultivation progress was not far behind the geniuses in the sect.
"Little friend Qin, come with me." Shopkeeper Xue took Qin Huaian to a separate room.
"Shop Manager Xue, take a look at this." Qin Huaian took out a Qi Restoration Pill he had refined and handed it to Shopkeeper Xue.
Shopkeeper Xue held the elixir and observed it carefully, then sniffed it gently. His heart was slightly moved, but he asked uncertainly: "Little friend Qin, is this Qi elixir?"
"It's what I just refined."
"Seriously?!" Shopkeeper Xue took a step forward and stared at Qin Huaian. In fact, he didn't suspect Qin Huaian of lying to him, because Qin Huaian had no need to lie to him. But I was so shocked inside that I couldn't help but speak out.
Shopkeeper Xue is also a first-level alchemist. He understands how much effort it takes to become a first-level alchemist, and more importantly, it requires a lot of spiritual herbs and time.
It took Qin Huaian only two months to refine the first-level Qi Restoration Pill. This was something that could no longer be achieved through hard work. This requires extremely strong alchemy talent!
"Yes, Shopkeeper Qin, I accidentally obtained the refining method of the Qi Restoration Pill in the Million Mountains, and I wanted to try to see if I can successfully refine it."
